title: Exclusive Live Webinar Rethinking Tax Transformation: 2026 Global Benchmark Insights
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
Join SAPinsider’s Robert Holland and industry experts from Vertex, Inc., SAP and KPMG as they break down the key findings from the recently published Global Tax Management Benchmark Research Report.


This interactive webinar will explore the strategies, technologies, and operating model changes that distinguish leading organizations from those struggling to keep pace with evolving compliance requirements. Learn where tax leaders are investing, how they are preparing for AI-enabled operations, and what steps they can take today to improve compliance, governance, and business outcomes.


## Register Now to:


- **Gain exclusive insights** from SAPinsider’s 2026 Global Tax Management Benchmark Research and understand the forces shaping tax transformation over the next 24 months.
- **Identify top drivers:** Learn why AI adoption, e-invoicing mandates, and regulatory volatility are now the top drivers of tax strategy.
- **Analyze the data:** Understand why 41% of organizations are prioritizing automation and 35% are focused on master data remediation and ownership.
- **Bridge the execution gap:** Explore the growing gap between expected and realized outcomes from tax automation and AI initiatives—and discover how leading organizations are addressing it.
- **Optimize your SAP ecosystem:** Learn how organizations are leveraging SAP S/4HANA, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, SAP BTP, and third-party tax engines to build scalable compliance frameworks.
- **Evaluate AI use cases:** Discover the most promising AI and automation use cases being evaluated and deployed within modern tax functions.
- **Enhance governance:** Learn best practices for improving tax data quality, governance, process standardization, and regulatory readiness.
- **Accelerate performance:** Walk away with practical recommendations from SAPinsider research to help your organization accelerate tax transformation and improve compliance performance.


**Register**[Now](https://sapinsider.org/webinars/sapinsider-research-findings-webinar-global-tax-management-trends-challenges-and-priorities-for-2026-and-beyond?hs-embed-af=t)
